name: process
description: Writes and reads the Process database that the gtm-operator setup plugin created: the living reference of how and why things are done. Finds current answers, audits stale or conflicting artifacts, and sweeps scoped documents, conversations, meetings, CRM activity, billing, and spend evidence for missing process knowledge. Proposes candidates a person approves one at a time, writes no owner or verification stamp onto imports, creates no database, and writes no config.
